extract.stopIfNoNewLabel: Stop early when no new data is found
extract.maxPassesHint: How many expansion rounds to run for one extract call.
extract.scrollBetweenHint: Scroll slightly between rounds to trigger lazy-loaded blocks.
extract.scrollDistanceHint: Scroll ratio per round (0-1). Lower is safer.
extract.lazyHydrationRoundsHint: Repeat "See more" taps until the UI tree stabilizes. Mainly used for Facebook post extraction.
extract.lazyHydrationScrollDistanceHint: Scroll amount (0–1) for the lazy expansion step. Default 0.3 is usually fine.
extract.prefetchScrollPassesHint: Light feed scrolls before parsing so below-the-fold content gets nodes. Only runs if > 0; Facebook posts only.
extract.prefetchScrollPauseHint: Wait after each prefetch scroll for content to render.
extract.completionRetriesHint: Extra retries to re-expand/re-parse when posts are still truncated. Set 0 to disable retries and avoid repeated taps.
extract.maxItemsHint: Max comments parsed in one extract call.
extract.parentPostIdVarHint: Auto mode is recommended. Use custom variable only for special flows.
extract.noNewThresholdHint: Stop after N consecutive rounds with no new items.
extract.resultVarHint: Optional override target variable. Leave empty to use default context variable.

saveExtraction.dataVarHint: Variable name produced by extract step. Example: comments, posts.
saveExtraction.dedupeFieldHint: Use comment_key for comments and post_key for posts to avoid duplicates/wrong links.
saveExtraction.parentIdVarHint: Recommended: use auto mode so comments are linked to the currently opened post.
